grammar_tips.title: Reporting Verbs in Diplomacy
grammar_tips.explanation: Use verbs like 'stated', 'announced', 'claimed', and 'argued' to report what others say. Example: 'The ambassador stated that the talks were productive.'

grammar_tips.title: Conditional Sentences in International Relations
grammar_tips.explanation: Use conditionals to discuss possible results. Example: 'If the treaty is signed, sanctions will be lifted.'
